setup.instruction: Wait for the editing-size readout so the editor has booted.
Wait for the demo controls to become interactive.

intro_walkthrough.instruction: Establish the editor with the game view and the HUD tree visible.

source.before: The editor was cramped at 1440p, and moving the browser to a second monitor could collapse the layout outright.
source.after: A UI-scale control sets the editor chrome to a size you can work in, and it survives a reload. Moving the window between monitors keeps the layout intact.
source.value: You can work at the size your screen deserves, and the editor stays where you put it.

treatments.text: Set the editor to a size you can actually work at, and it stays there.

walkthrough.instruction: Wait for the editor scale control.
Hold while the narration explains the scale control.

source.before: Placement meant typing raw coordinates, and nothing on screen told you what an element was positioned against.
source.after: The inspector leads with the anchor — a parent element or screen edge, an alignment and an order — and the stage draws the relationship. `pos_x` and `pos_y` become the offsets from that anchor. Raw coordinate entry is still there when you want it.
source.value: A drag reads as "re-anchor plus offset" instead of a number you have to reverse-engineer later.

treatments.text: Anchor an element to a parent, then nudge it. The stage shows the relationship.

walkthrough.instruction: Select the health element so the inspector shows its anchor.
Wait for the anchor field to render for the selected element.
Hold while the narration explains anchor first, offset second.

source.before: Lining two elements up was eyeballing, one pixel at a time.
source.after: Drags snap to a configurable grid and magnet to other elements' edges and centres, with guides showing what they caught. A visible toggle turns it off, and a held modifier bypasses it for one drag.
source.value: Alignment stops being a test of patience. The export still contains final positions and nothing else.

treatments.text: Snap to a grid, magnet to other elements, hold Alt to bypass.

walkthrough.instruction: Wait for the drag assistance block.
Hold while the narration explains grid, magnet and the Alt bypass.

source.before: Pause existed, but you had to wait for a useful frame to appear before there was anything to line the HUD up against.
source.after: Named preset moments seek the demo to a deterministic point — a frame with full HUD activity, a scoreboard moment, a quiet moment.
source.value: The frame you need is one click away instead of a wait, and it is the same frame every time.

treatments.text: Jump straight to a frame worth aiming at.

walkthrough.instruction: Wait for the demo moments group.
Hold while the narration explains the preset moments.
